question: Will Fernando Cerimedo be released from preventive detention in Bolivia by October 31, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Cerimedo is held under two independent six-month preventive-detention orders (illicit enrichment, Aug 29, Chonchocoro, upheld on appeal in Sept; attempted femicide, Aug 21, ratified by an appeals chamber on Oct 7, which assigned that measure to Palmasola). Release requires both lifted within the 9 days left (Oct 22-31). His defense publicly expects release in November, not October; a hearing to cease detention in the femicide case is being prepared but no date was found. The disruption of the prosecution (Mariaca detained) and political turmoil over leaked audios are the only upside drivers. Status quo strongly favors NO. No prediction market found.
calls.dossier:
- Aug 18 2026: Cerimedo arrested at Viru Viru airport; Aug 21 the court ordered 180 days of preventive detention for attempted femicide against Nadia Beller (Palmasola). Source: Oxigeno.bo, La Nacion.
- Aug 29 2026: Judge Douglas Borda ordered a second 6-month preventive detention (illicit enrichment, about 35k EUR found at his La Paz home), to be served at Chonchocoro; La Paz Penal Chamber II rejected the appeal; transferred Sept 7-8. Source: El Deber, Los Tiempos, BAE Negocios.
- Oct 6-7 2026: Appeals chamber ratified the 180-day femicide-case detention and ordered that measure be served in Palmasola; La Razon says no transfer order had been issued. Source: La Razon Oct 7, Infobae Oct 8, eju.tv.
- Defense (Giraldes) is preparing a hearing to cease preventive detention with 'new elements', asking for unconditional freedom or alternatively house arrest with permission to work; no hearing date found. Source: La Razon Oct 6, eldeber.
- Oct 1 2026: Argentine defense said there are procedural expectations he leaves prison in November. Source: Correo del Sur.
- Oct 11 2026: Still in Chonchocoro; Attorney General Mariaca and 14 officials detained late Sept; interim prosecutor Urioste now in charge; article says his situation 'improves each week'. Source: Aire de Santa Fe.
- Oct 15-19 2026: Cerimedo, speaking from Chonchocoro, disputes the leaked audios; VP Lara suspects Cerimedo is leaking audios to pressure the government for judicial benefits. Source: Red Uno Oct 15, El Pais Bolivia Oct 19.
- Four cases: attempted femicide (Santa Cruz), illicit enrichment (La Paz), domestic violence, drug trafficking (Beni).
- Status quo: held in prison under two independent detention orders; release requires both lifted or substituted.
- Resolves off credible reports of physical exit from a Bolivian penitentiary; a transfer between prisons does not count; unclear status resolves NO.
- Event window: now -> Oct 31 2026 23:59 Bolivia time; as of Oct 22 roughly 9 days remain (window effectively started with detention Aug 18; about 87% of the Aug 18-Oct 31 span elapsed).
- Searched, not found: any scheduled hearing date to cease detention, any ruling lifting either order, prediction markets (none on Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi).

calls.reconciliation: All three runs found the same facts: two ratified six-month orders, no hearing scheduled to end the detention, the defense expecting release in November, and prosecution disruption after AG Mariaca's arrest. No factual disputes were found. The only judgment call was how much weight to give tail risk from political interference; all three put it at about 3%, and I agree because the double order and the 9-day window make release by Oct 31 very unlikely. No web access on this run, so nothing new was checked.
